Following the analytical matrix (*mātikā*) of the Abhidhamma, this section investigates the operation of twenty-four conditional relations (*paccaya*) upon states classified under the dyad of phenomena that are both taints (*āsava*) and associated with taints (*āsavasampayutta*) [SuttaCentral].
